metadata.description: A production-ready Next.js, Clerk and Supabase starter.

home.title: Ship your idea, not your boilerplate
home.subtitle: Authentication, a secured Postgres database, file storage, internationalisation and a test suite, wired together and ready to build on.

auth.title: Clerk authentication
auth.description: Sign-in, sign-up, social logins and account management, protected routes enforced in the proxy.

database.title: Supabase with row level security
database.description: Versioned migrations, generated types and policy tests. Users can only ever touch their own rows.

storage.title: File uploads
storage.description: Avatar uploads to Supabase Storage, compressed in the browser and scoped to each user's folder.

quality.title: Tested and typed
quality.description: Strict TypeScript, validated environment, Vitest, Playwright, pgTAP and CI on every pull request.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear in the app.
profile.avatarHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 2 MB.
profile.emailHint: Change your email under Account and security.
profile.bioHint: A few words about yourself. Up to 300 characters.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Customise how the app looks and which language it speaks.

account.title: Account and security
account.description: Email addresses, password, connected accounts and active sessions.

admin.title: Users
admin.description: Everyone with a profile. Visible to admins only.

validation.firstNameTooLong: First name must be 64 characters or fewer.
validation.lastNameTooLong: Last name must be 64 characters or fewer.
validation.bioTooLong: Bio must be 300 characters or fewer.
validation.dateInFuture: Date of birth cannot be in the future.
validation.avatarTooLarge: Image must be 2 MB or smaller.
validation.avatarWrongType: Use a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.

errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

setup.setupDescription: Connect authentication and database. About 5 minutes.
setup.skipForNow: Skip for now and preview the site
setup.bannerDescription: to enable sign-in and the database.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: We use essential cookies to run the site. With your permission we also use analytics cookies to understand how it is used.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: An unexpected error occurred. Try again, and if it keeps happening, contact us.
